RQD-C1.prompt_excerpt: Write a TagList component. It receives `tags: string[]` and renders them as `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">`. Each tag shows the text inside a styled pill. No loading state needed. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-C1.output:
Created `src/components/TagList/TagList.tsx` and `TagList.css`.

**Component:** `TagList` accepts `tags: string[]`, renders a `<ul role="list">` with `<li>` + `<span>` pill per tag. Named export, no I/O, no loading state.

**CSS:** Uses `@layer components`, defines `--shelf-tag-*` component-tier token aliases in `:root` + both dark-mode blocks, kebab-case class names, no raw values.
